assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is performed with CPT code 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries
There is a concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of the collapse events
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The service addresses the payer's medical necessity determination for diagnosis code R55
The service addresses the payer's medical necessity determination for diagnosis code I25.10
The service corresponds to CPT code 93229 for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
